raw:
@q query
  select ?s
  where all
    match
      relation "be a guest at"
      role subject ?g
      role object "the Brno workshop"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "talk to"
      role subject ?g
      role object ?s
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
